limitations: The recorded panel is the deterministic mock driver (a grep-only stand-in with no tool access and no API key). claude-code and codex binaries were discovered runnable on the recording machine but not invoked for this record; their headless invocations are exercised by the spawn-mocked driver tests, and any real run is one command away (ergolab run demo-mcp with no --agents).

The gemini-cli headless invocation is unverified end to end: no gemini binary exists on the recording machine, so its driver resolves as skipped (not-found) and its flags are coded from the CLI's documented non-interactive mode only.
One sequential sample per agent-task pair — no repeats, no confidence intervals. The report surfaces cliffs (0 of 6), not fine differences.
Wall times are machine-specific (this record: darwin arm64); treat them as orders of magnitude, not benchmarks.
The demo gif (assets/ergolab-demo.gif) records the showcase run exactly as listed above; its pacing is condensed for reading, the output is real.
